newsitem.title: USA: Metal Recovery sees 10,000 tons processed in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Metal Recovery sees 10,000 tons processed in Q1.

text.p: Metal Recovery Technologies Inc said Tuesday it expects to process a minimum of 10,000 tons of scrap to be processed into high quality "black scrap" and 99.8 percent pure zinc in the first quarter.
The commercial zinc recycler said it has leased a scrap shredder in order to meet the raw-material needs of its East Coast facility and has secured new steel scrap supply contracts.
"The lack of available shredding capacity retarded our progress in the last quarter of 1996," William Morgan, inventor of the recycling process said.
